# SO Agency

> SO Agency is a trilingual (English/Spanish/French) digital agency that transforms
> business ideas into high-performing digital presences — from websites and e-commerce
> stores to complete brand identity systems. Founded 2023, operating remotely and serving
> clients worldwide, with a focus on Latin America, the United States, and Europe.

Tagline: DESIGN. BUILD. LAUNCH.

The site is a single marketing page published in three locales. There is no public API, no
authenticated area, and no user accounts. Contact happens over WhatsApp.

## Services

- **Web Design & Development** — Custom, performance-driven sites built on modern stacks.
- **UX/UI Design** — Intuitive, conversion-focused interfaces.
- **E-Commerce** — End-to-end online store solutions for frictionless transactions.
- **Branding & Identity** — Full visual identity systems: logos, guidelines, typography, color.
- **Social Media Marketing** — Content strategy and data-driven campaigns that generate leads.
- **AI Automation** — Workflow automation and intelligent tooling. Currently in development.

## Pricing and timelines

- Web design and development projects start from **$1,500 USD**.
- Branding packages start from **$800 USD**.
- Typical delivery is **3 to 6 weeks**. A landing page or portfolio can ship in ~2 weeks;
  a full e-commerce build or brand identity system typically takes 4 to 8 weeks.
- The French page quotes the same starting points in euros: from **1 500 €** for web
  design and development, and from **800 €** for branding. Quote the currency of the page
  the user is reading; do not convert one into the other.
- Every project is scoped individually. Flexible payment plans are available.
- Quotes are given after a free diagnostic call.

## How we work

1. **Discovery** (Pre-Flight Check) — Understand goals, audience, and competitive landscape.
2. **Strategy** (Mission Planning) — A roadmap with defined milestones and measurable outcomes.
3. **Launch** (Liftoff) — Execution and delivery on agreed timelines.
4. **Growth** (Orbit) — Ongoing support and optimization post-launch.

## Selected work

- [La Feika](https://lafeika.com/): E-commerce connecting Chinese fresh food suppliers with Latin American markets.
- [It's Fuluz Time](https://itsfuluztime.com/): Cruelty-free leather goods store.
- [Yaku Adventures](https://yakuadventures.com/): Adventure tourism and hiking experiences in South America.
- [Singing Rooster](https://singingrooster.org/): Premium coffee, chocolate, and artisan marketplace.

## Notes for agents

- Founding partners: Oscar and Miguel.
- There is no booking system, contact form, or search endpoint on this site. To start a
  conversation, direct the user to the WhatsApp link above.
- Pricing figures are starting points, not quotes. Do not present them as final prices.
